scope: read-only production metadata and aggregate SQL; no private article bodies, portfolios or credentials exported

measurement.population: events whose fetched_at is within the trailing window, deduplicated event rows, not frontend-visible count
measurement.delay: nonnegative fetched_at minus published_at for published_at_status=verified, hours; source timestamps not independently verified
measurement.commodity_mentions: case-insensitive title plus snippet match: 铜 or whole-word copper; 黄金/金价 or whole-word gold; 白银 or whole-word silver; 原油/石油 or whole-word crude/brent/WTI
measurement.discovery_channel_note: Bing News is a discovery channel; it does not identify the original publisher or prove source independence

user_confirmed_preferences.instruments: Stocks and ETFs primarily, global markets
user_confirmed_preferences.latency_target: Low-cost 5–15-minute monitoring; provider delay must be separately stated

architecture_gaps: Person-based retrieval and attribution gate excludes independent commodity events
Bing-first concatenation with per-person result cap can crowd out alternate discovery
Gold/oil quote snapshots do not feed upward price anomaly detectors
Daily-bar 1D/3D/5D post-event validation is not intraday detection
Source channel and original publisher lack separate fields
Existing browser attention state is not server-side push

source_evidence.finding: Intraday web data delayed at least 15 minutes; not proof of a free licensed API
Public stocks breakdown daily Excel delayed two days; other inventory products have distinct delivery terms
10-minute delayed JSON and real-time WebSocket products require appropriate access and licensing
Daily trading/warrant and weekly inventory reports, with upstream frequency preserved
Calendar-driven energy reports, honor holiday changes
Weekly/monthly fund-flow background, not intraday flows
Industry association bulletin published October 9 reports October 8 prices and physical-market context; not an October 12 live quote

proposal_status: Design proposal only; no new collector, monitoring rule or notification deployed
connectivity_limit: One direct server GET per public entry page; HTTP 200 does not prove data completeness, parsing, permission for automation, or a stable API. LME 403 is the result of this probe, not a permanent availability claim.

discovery_tracks: Licensed/permissioned instrument prices and rule-based anomalies
Industry reporting and KOL interpretation as supporting context

latency_contract.fast_path: As soon as fresh eligible facts enter the system, deterministic rules create a fact card before AI interpretation
latency_contract.target: Source-available-to-visible p95 <= 15 minutes for selected enabled feeds, proposed and not yet measured
latency_contract.price_demo: 15-minute source delay + 0–5-minute poll wait + processing is at least 15–20 minutes plus processing; not 5-minute real-time

proposed_triggers: Price/volume or cross-market confirmation where timestamps and sessions align
Inventory/available-warrant changes and nearby spreads on their real release schedule
proposed_design.instrument_registry: Separate commodity theme, exchange, contract, spot/ETF/share, currency, unit and trading calendar. ETF exposure and company revenue exposure require dated evidence; commodity moves are not stock returns.
proposed_design.event_storage: Persist source event and revisions, raw observation timestamps, availability/capture/alert times and entity links. Do not mix minute and daily bars under the old interval-free unique key.
proposed_design.ranking: Separate urgency from research value; use source quality, novelty, exposure relevance, magnitude, market reaction and evidence maturity. No invented buy probability.
proposed_design.notification_design: Durable event outbox and delivery dedupe, cooldown and material-update notifications, retract or downgrade corrections; independent of browser being open. Delivery channel remains to be selected.
proposed_design.model_cost: Keep critical fact detection independent of DeepSeek. Summarize material new evidence once, cache by evidence version, use budget caps; longer background reading can retain peak/off-peak cadence.
delivery_order: Verify permissions, actual timestamps and server access for a narrow copper/gold price universe; fix source/publisher labeling and define first-party feed set
Connect copper/gold observation/rules/persistent events/stocks-ETF mapping with two separate latency metrics
Add evidence-driven research cards and a reliable delivery outbox; run 7–14 days of shadow evaluation before broadening
proposed_design.acceptance: Historical replay must use information availability times without look-ahead; measure defined-event recall, false positives, duplicate notifications, source availability and end-to-end latency. Hypotheses and thresholds remain proposed.
proposed_design.prototype_status: Offline scenario demonstration, no market data or notification delivery; browser syntax/interaction/keyboard and desktop/mobile overflow checks passed
